comparison.primaryInterpretation: Declared procedure/configuration comparison on a shared tool adapter; neither raw chat nor unchanged historical-platform comparison.
comparison.historicalToolConfound: The historical product did not advertise the current acquisition tools. Common-tool migration is explicit; any additional tool/evidence/model/resource/facts difference must be declared before dispatch.
comparison.commonFactsNormalization: Only adaptiveExecution.prompt and its derived pilotPlanIntentHash are omitted from the comparison condition. Full workerFactsHash remains bound; every other input including candidate-memory policy remains significant.
comparison.orderPolicy: Independently select and seal a fixed order before execution; coordinator does not generate randomness or claim counterbalancing.
comparison.claimLimit: One exploratory run per arm is not statistical superiority, customer validation, profit or general worker qualification.

lineageAndAblation.transferMeaning: New service task/source context within each same-arm synthetic business; no invented cross-business relationship or material-transfer authority.
matchedFields: normalized task facts excluding only memoryPolicy and derived pilotPlanIntentHash
lineageAndAblation.maskBoundary: Candidate context/list/import/reuse/reuseOutcome access only; copied portfolio artifacts and other business evidence remain in both arms.
lineageAndAblation.candidateAbsent: Do not fabricate a candidate; record not-run and retain the unused allocation.

coordinator.phaseBinding: All three flagship stages can defer their four hashes together in one later chunk. Development starts under the full fixed allocation; no flagship starts until the complete cohort is bound and actual configurations are distinct. Each deferred chunk binds after preceding stages complete; root/arm/case/phase/allowance cannot change.
coordinator.wholeProposalPreparation: Expand the three-arm template to these eleven stages and fixed total. Bind development initially; preregister population, case IDs, selection rules and rubric with a fixed order. Independent job materials, actual worker-facts/evidence/configuration hashes and fresh grants are supplied only through whole-chunk binding. This JSON is not the executable manifest.
coordinator.standaloneDevelopmentDistinction: The proposed development path uses the coordinator's whole-release lease and allocation. Direct standalone journey invocation enforces only its own grant and is not the proposed execution path.

localPolicy.backend: Windows WSL bubblewrap plus systemd user cgroups
localPolicy.actualHostChecks: Command execution/path/network denial, process fanout, owner cancellation, deadlines and trusted-completion restart recovery; see docs/intelligence/EXECUTION.md.
localPolicy.serviceScope: Task-bound private loopback; every started service needs confirmed stop before finalization.
localPolicy.policyStatus: Final task grants must bind exact hosts and installed policies. Per-unit OS limits are implemented; monitored storage is not a filesystem quota.

initialDevelopment.discovery: Separate exact journey discovery seeds/limits; see trial-preparation.v1.json
initialDevelopment.localToolRunRule: Math.min(128,Math.max(32,node.calls*4)), then at least node.calls+8; derived by existing outcome materialization. For proposed12/5 calls this gives48/32.

laterIndependentJobsProposedAcquisition.status: Unbound defaults for later jobs only; not the current development grant. Exact hosts and caps require each prospective signed job.

timeAndPeople.finiteControls: Per-call/count/retrieval/completion limits, same-ID resume window and exact absolute grant expiry; no unsupported 48-hour aggregate wall claim.
